messages.subject: data table of RGSOC projects
parts:
Dear RGSOC participants, I have created a data table of past RGSOC projects
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/blob/master/projects.csv I spent
quite a bit of time cleaning it, trying to make sure that each participant
has a unique name. However there still may be a few errors, so feel free to
submit a PR if you notice anything that should be changed.

There is an R script
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2017/blob/master/figure-projects.R that
I have been using to analyze these data. For example I created the
following table which summarizes all past students who came back as mentors
(including 5 mentors for 6 projects in 2017)

> (show.cameback <- unique(cameback[, list(
+   student.project=substr(
projects, 1, 15),
+   years, person=mentor, year,
+   project.mentored=substr(project, 1, 15))][order(
+     years, student.project, person, year, project.mentored)]))
